showcase.title: Quick Collage Maker
showcase.subtitle: Upload your photos, pick a custom layout template, adjust canvas dimensions and spacing, and export high-quality collages instantly.

tips.tip1: Upload 2 to 10 photos to start assembling your custom collage layout.
tips.tip2: Reorder your photos in Stage 1 to control which image goes into which cell.
tips.tip3: Adjust outer padding and inner cell gaps in Stage 2 to style your grid.
tips.tip4: Fine-tune individual photo zoom, panning, and frame borders in Stage 3.

faqs.q1: How many photos can I combine at once?
faqs.a1: You can upload and collage between 2 and 10 photos. The tool automatically generates and recommends grid layouts tailored to your exact photo count.
faqs.q2: How do I place a specific photo into a particular frame cell?
faqs.a2: In Stage 1 (Prepare Images), simply drag and drop the photo cards to reorder them. Item #1 in the queue corresponds to cell #1 in the layout grid.
faqs.q3: Can I customize canvas dimensions and frame gaps?
faqs.a3: Yes. In Stage 2, you can adjust canvas dimensions (Pixels, Inches, CM, MM with custom DPI), outer margins, and horizontal/vertical gaps between frames.
faqs.q4: Can I zoom, pan, and transform individual photos?
faqs.a4: Yes. In Stage 3, click any photo layer to zoom, pan, rotate, flip, or use Quick Actions to adjust Fit modes, border radius, and border colors.
faqs.q5: What is the export quality of the collage image?
faqs.a5: All processing and rendering happens entirely on-device in your browser at full canvas resolution, preserving sharp quality across formats.
